name: Sidebar
purpose: Provides the persistent or collapsible side navigation panel; the tablet/desktop member of the Navigation morph pair with TabBar.
scenarios: Show top-level destinations beside the content on desktop
Collapse navigation to a rail on tablet widths
Highlight the current destination with aria-current

label.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.

items.description: Array of destinations with value and label.

header.description: Optional content above the navigation list.

activeValue.description: Value of the current destination; sets aria-current.

onSelect.description: Called with the destination value when an item is activated.

onCollapsedChange.description: Called when the collapsed state changes.

states.name: collapsed
states.description: 4.5rem rail; labels hidden, items keep accessible names.

antiPatterns: Do not render the sidebar and the tab bar for the same destination set at one breakpoint.
Do not put the only navigation in the sidebar without a compact alternative (tab-bar).

keyboard: Tab moves through items and the toggle
a11y.focus: Document order is header, items, toggle; the collapse toggle exposes aria-expanded and aria-controls.
a11y.labeling: The aside and nav landmarks are labelled via the label prop; collapsed items keep aria-label text.

responsive.strategy: Desktop form of the Navigation morph: persistent 16rem panel. Collapses to a 4.5rem rail via the toggle or when its own host slot narrows to 12rem (container query). On compact the shell replaces it with tab-bar.

breakpoints.compact: Composition contract: app-shell uses tab-bar instead; a directly rendered sidebar still works as an inline panel.
breakpoints.medium: Collapsible sidebar; in a 12rem host slot it switches to the label-free rail via container query.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only; the border is on the inline-end, items align to inline-start, and the directional collapse chevron mirrors under [dir=rtl].
